title: Chapter 159 Resource Exchange Stone
content:
Chapter 159 Resource Exchange Stone

Wang Shuo was in a trance for a long time before he came back to his senses.

He took out the dungeon token, and several interfaces appeared in front of him. The first page was a basic introduction to the dungeon.

Including area, coordinates, monster types...

There was a lot of information, and Wang Shuo just glanced through it roughly.

The resource page at the back immediately attracted Wang Shuo's attention.

It showed all the resources in this dungeon, including the number of energy crystals and soul crystals.

Wang Shuo's breathing was rapid, because the numbers on it really made him unable to calm down.

Soul crystals 100,000, energy crystals 60 million.

Wang Shuo turned his head to look at Mira and said coldly: "Mira, how many resources did you consume in total for resurrection?"

"Reporting to the master, 100,000 soul crystals! I can't remember the energy crystals."

Wang Shuo looked at the lines on Mira's body surging, and said sternly: "Tell the truth."

"1 million?"

"Tell the truth!" Wang Shuo roared angrily.

"Master, I can't remember, at least 5 million soul crystals."

At this time, Mira said in a trembling voice.

The body kept shrinking.

Wang Shuo's heart was bleeding. He could only take a deep breath, look up at the sky, and suppress his anger.

After a while, Wang Shuo calmed down.

He said to Mira: "From now on, you have to work harder and try to make up for the resources you consumed as soon as possible, understand?"

"Yes, yes, master!"

For the resources in the copy, Wang Shuo can take them back if he wants, but in this way, this copy will become worthless.

At this time, Wang Shuo has already made a plan. In the future, this place can be opened to other gangs or mercenaries and charged fees.

In this way, they get a level upgrade, and he can earn fees.

Back to the territory, Wang Shuo placed the exchange stone on the edge of the central square outside the lord's mansion, which is also convenient for others to exchange items, so as to speed up the upgrade of the resource exchange stone.

I saw a small stone the size of a palm suddenly turned into a square stone pillar as high as a person.

After Wang Shuo touched it with his hand, the exchange interface popped up in front of him.

After browsing all the exchange items, he found that the things that can be exchanged inside were seriously reduced.

It was far from the kind that Zhao Bangde showed him, which was full of various items.

Now there are only various sophisticated equipment and tool people.

Even the horse card is gone.

Wang Shuo shook his head helplessly. It seems that there will be more items only after the upgrade.

However, the exchange of tool people has become less restricted. In the interface, there are a total of 200 tool people displayed, but there are only 5 with A-level qualifications and 10 with B-level qualifications. There is also a refresh function.

Wang Shuo couldn't wait to recruit 5 A-level qualifications, and each person spent 1,000 energy crystals.

It's about 10,000 gold coins each, and the level has reached level 10.

Wang Shuo thought, if the exchange stone is upgraded to level 2, will the summoned tool person be directly level 20?

The cost of refreshing once is also 1,000 energy crystals.

Wang Shuo has a lot of energy crystals now.

Before, there were more than 6 million. Although some of it was used up, it was only a fraction.

Just now in the dungeon, I got nearly 200,000. In the short term, there is no worry at all.

Click refresh directly.

Four more tools with A-level qualifications appeared.

After refreshing 10 times, Wang Shuo found that he could not refresh anymore.

It seems that he can only refresh 10 times a day.

Wang Shuo recruited 50 people in total.

At this time, Wang Shuo remembered that he seemed to need to buy a cavalry transfer certificate.

He immediately searched and found that there was indeed no transfer certificate. He was so angry!

Barbie Q!
